_doc: Hand-written rules for shops.json, read by build_reference.py. Every shop name and place comes from the game's object containers; these rules only word them. `kinds`: the first rule whose `pattern` matches the shop name and whose `inventory` equals the shop's inventory type in the game files (COMMODITY or ITEM) gives the kind; a rule without one of the two ignores it. `labels`: the first pattern matching the shop name gives its display name; without one, a shop franchise name from the game (ShopFranchise records) that appears in the shop name, else the shop name itself in words. `shops`: per-name overrides, field by field.
